entities.name: Mosque Nur ul-Ihsan
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Nur ul-Ihsan Mosque was, until 2018, the oldest mosque in Phnom Penh, the capital of Cambodia. It was situated 7 km north of the centre of the city.
